samples.description: Complete-case on shared loan and firm controls, 1999-09-01 through 2008-12-31 syndicated facilities linked to SOX 302 material-weakness firms; facilities in the three-year prior, explicit uncorrected, or three-year post-clean-report periods; firms have at least one prior and at least one uncorrected or corrected facility. General Covenants remains missing where source components are incomplete and its regression uses observed outcomes.

Restricted facility sample of PP contracts with classified accounting-ratio or credit-rating grids and observed S&P, Moody's, Fitch, or DPR senior-debt ratings; borrowers have rated PP facilities both before and after the first ICW report.

assumptions: OLS is the best-effort interpretation of the paper's unnamed linear regression.

Audit Analytics COMPANY_FKEY is matched directly to Compustat CIK within accounting-coverage years. A dated CRSP/CCM facility route requires exact borrower-name agreement with historical CRSP issuer names; the independent LEI route requires unique direct-company, name, and CIK confirmation. Conflicts are unmatched. The paper's four-agency senior-debt fallback is reconstructed from Compustat S&P and date-valid FISD issue history; ambiguous issue grades remain unavailable. Its exact 1–27 crosswalk is not published, so the explicit raw-grade notch conversion is best-effort.
OLS is the best-effort interpretation of the paper's unnamed linear regression.

All-in-Drawn spread uses LIBOR or LIBOR-equivalent pricing rows. Loan size uses the exact LoanConnector tranche bridge to converted USD amount; historical revisions and facility borrower mapping remain best-effort.

Probit follows Table 5. Collateral values are mapped from explicit local yes/no codes; historical DealScan borrower links use dated name-confirmed CRSP/CCM or exact-tranche LEI routes with direct-company and CIK corroboration.
OLS is the best-effort interpretation of the paper's unnamed linear regression.

General covenants sum the five Appendix A provisions. A positive numeric sweep field or explicit Yes is treated as provision present; an explicit zero or No is treated as absent. The assigned catalog and provider pointers do not define blank semantics, so blanks and unknown codes remain missing; duplicate cardinality is checked and the model uses the observed-outcome subsample.
OLS is the best-effort interpretation of the paper's unnamed linear regression.
DealScan maturity in months is used and logged as the dependent variable. Credit rating squared is included as the paper specifies.

Probit follows Table 6. The restricted sample requires an observed S&P, Moody's, Fitch, or DPR senior-debt rating and rated PP facilities before and after the first report; this before/after screen is applied within the shared complete-case sample before retaining classified PP Ratio outcomes. Only explicit accounting-ratio and credit-rating pricing types are classified.

FISD provides issue-level ratings, so only mapped active SEN/SS issues with one common current grade per agency contribute. Conflicting grades or unavailable date-valid issue links remain missing and do not become score 28. The exact paper cross-agency 1–27 conversion is not printed; the raw-grade notch mapping is best-effort.

limitations: The frozen feasibility route names SOX 404, but the original paper requires SOX 302; construction uses the catalog-listed SOX 302 disclosure-controls table and verifies local numeric flag frequencies.

Facility borrower coverage is conservative: the dated CRSP/CCM route requires exact contemporaneous name agreement, and the independent LEI route requires direct-company name and CIK confirmation. Conflicting unique routes are left unmatched.
The current local data vintage and DealScan historical revisions are not certified as the authors' vintage; only unique tranche amount and borrower matches are retained.

The Bond-CRSP link file starts in July 2002. Earlier FISD issue ratings cannot be verified through the date-valid bond-to-equity bridge; missing rating history or conflicts remain unavailable instead of receiving score 28.

The appendix does not publish the exact cross-agency rating-score conversion, and local sources provide agency grade strings rather than the paper's converted 1–27 scores. The explicit ordinal notch conversion is best-effort; unrecognized grades remain unavailable.

Local coverage is much narrower than the paper: 11,356 of 133,309 dated DealScan facilities passed the conservative borrower routes. Of 1,645 facilities in linked-report event windows, 738 have an observed rating score and 907 have no score, including unavailable mapping/history and conflict states rather than only confirmed unrated firms; 414 pass the shared complete-case screen. The prior/post requirement retains 223 facilities across 45 borrowers. No sample was relaxed to approach the paper's N=2,828.

After applying rated-PP pre/post eligibility within the common complete-case sample, the PP Ratio file has 89 classifiable facilities across 27 firms; the probit estimates on 88 after one perfect-prediction exclusion. Attempt_02 reports PP Ratio descriptives on the 89-row pre-estimation restricted file, consistent with the paper's Table 2/Table 6 population. The paper's exact order of its borrower-level PP restriction relative to complete-case screening is not stated.

Annual firm controls use the latest eligible DATADATE in the preceding calendar year. Appendix A does not resolve calendar year versus latest fiscal report; selected source ages are 6–697 days (median 213). This timing interpretation is best effort, not a demonstrated exact authors' convention.
